summary: All 4 requested frontend flows PASS against LIVE https://api.neksathi.in with demo@neksathi.app. (1) ALERTS INBOX — after login on Security tab, the bell icon (testID 'security-alerts-inbox') opens /alerts-inbox titled 'Scan Alerts'; 10 alert rows render with plate 'MH14DEMO01', humanised type 'Wrong Parking · 6m Ago', and the teal map-pin badge on the first row (has finder location). (2) ALERT DETAIL — tapping the first row navigates to /alert-detail showing the 'Wrong Parking' badge, timestamp '9/2/2026, 10:43:52 AM', 'No note left by the finder.' muted text, the web map fallback 'Map view available on the mobile app', coordinates '19.07600, 72.87700', an 'Open in Maps' link, and the 'Call finder (+919812345678)' button (testID 'alert-call-finder', tel: link). (3) RING OVERLAY REGRESSION — browser-side POST to /api/public/qr/9a85011b-.../call/start returned 200 with a call_id; within ~6s the responsive incoming-call overlay (testID 'incoming-call-overlay') appeared showing 'Someone needs to reach you about vehicle MH14DEMO01' with Decline/Accept, and Decline dismissed it cleanly. No crash from ringtone on web (expo-audio best-effort). (4) TOAST + SMOKE — POST /api/public/qr/.../incident with {type:'wrong_parking'} returned 200 and within ~14s the '🔔 New wrong parking on MH14DEMO01' toast appeared over the Security tab; app stayed healthy (tab-security present). Ringtone asset present at /app/frontend/assets/sounds/ringtone.wav (264KB) and bundled without error. Only cosmetic web warnings remain: 'shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated' and 'expo-notifications listener not supported on web' — no functional impact.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic-only web-preview warnings 'shadow* deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated'. No functional impact; native build unaffected. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveOverlays.tsx

action_items: Optional cosmetic: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence web-preview deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: alerts-inbox.tsx correctly guards for empty state, primes null vs [] distinctly, uses testID `alert-row-<id>` per row and threads finder lat/lng/phone/note/created into /alert-detail params.
alert-detail.tsx uses the ScanMap.web.tsx fallback ('Map view available on the mobile app') and correctly opens platform-specific maps URL from lat,lng.

LiveOverlays.tsx uses expo-audio (useAudioPlayer + setAudioModeAsync) — NOT the deprecated expo-av — matching current Expo guidance. Loop/seek/play wrapped in try/catch so web autoplay restrictions don't crash the app.
Alerts poll (15s) uses `alertsPrimed` ref to avoid firing toasts for historical alerts on first fetch — good UX pattern.
